reviewed_items.reviewer_notes: All 3 gates passed (public route handler; untrusted external entry point; src/app/auth/ is in-scope). However, Phase 03's proof trace is factually inconsistent with the current code: route.ts L123-143 actively queries member.members and signs out non-registered users before any redirect; dashboard/layout.tsx L120-123 further enforces membership with a redirect to /register/member-unregistered; and registerNewMember is absent from the codebase entirely. The property under test (authCallback must verify user exists in member.members) appears to be satisfied, making the described attack path (non-member → session → /dashboard/register → self-register) non-executable. Human review is needed to confirm whether Phase 03 analyzed stale/different code — a related real concern (fetchMemberStatus Discord server check commented out at L106-119) may warrant a separate finding.
